tools.name: onepagecrm_get_account
tools.description: Return the account's lead sources, deal stages, tags and the logged-in user's settings (date format, time zone). The request-signing key is left out. Good first call. OnePageCRM: GET /bootstrap.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_users
tools.description: List every user on the account with name, email, role and rights. OnePageCRM: GET /users.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the account's deal pipelines with their ordered stages. Use the ids with onepagecrm_list_deals. OnePageCRM: GET /pipelines.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_statuses
tools.description: List the contact statuses in their configured order, with counts. A contact's status field holds the system id used by change_contact_status. OnePageCRM: GET /statuses.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts you can access, filtered by search text, owner, company, status, tag, e-mail, phone or star. OnePageCRM: GET /contacts.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_get_contact
tools.description: Return one contact with its phones, e-mails, addresses, tags, status and custom fields. OnePageCRM: GET /contacts/{contact_id}.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_create_contact
tools.description: Create one contact. Give last_name or company_name (one is required). Nothing is e-mailed. OnePageCRM: POST /contacts.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_notes
tools.description: List the notes logged against contacts, optionally for one contact or company. OnePageCRM: GET /notes.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_create_contact_note
tools.description: Log a note against one contact. Optionally link it to a deal. OnePageCRM: POST /contacts/{contact_id}/notes.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_change_contact_status
tools.description: Move one contact to another status (for example from lead to customer). OnePageCRM: PUT /contacts/{contact_id}/change_status/{status_id}.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_companies
tools.description: List companies, filtered by search text, owner, status or tag. OnePageCRM: GET /companies.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_get_company
tools.description: Return one company with its fields and linked contacts. OnePageCRM: GET /companies/{company_id}.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_deals
tools.description: List deals, filtered by search text, status, owner, contact, company or pipeline. OnePageCRM: GET /deals.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_get_deal
tools.description: Return one deal with its value, stage, contact and custom fields. OnePageCRM: GET /deals/{deal_id}.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_actions
tools.description: List next actions (tasks), filtered by status (asap, date, date_time, waiting, queued, queued_with_date, done), contact, company or assignee. OnePageCRM: GET /actions.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_mark_action_done
tools.description: Mark one action (task) complete. OnePageCRM: PUT /actions/{action_id}/mark_as_done.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: onepagecrm_list_users · Private data: onepagecrm_list_statuses, onepagecrm_list_contacts, onepagecrm_get_contact, onepagecrm_create_contact, onepagecrm_list_notes, onepagecrm_create_contact_note, onepagecrm_change_contact_status, onepagecrm_get_company, onepagecrm_list_deals, onepagecrm_get_deal, onepagecrm_list_actions · Public sink: onepagecrm_list_users, onepagecrm_create_contact, onepagecrm_create_contact_note · Destructive: onepagecrm_get_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: onepagecrm_list_users · Private data: onepagecrm_list_statuses, onepagecrm_list_contacts, onepagecrm_get_contact, onepagecrm_create_contact, onepagecrm_list_notes, onepagecrm_create_contact_note, onepagecrm_change_contact_status, onepagecrm_get_company, onepagecrm_list_deals, onepagecrm_get_deal, onepagecrm_list_actions · Public sink: onepagecrm_list_users, onepagecrm_create_contact, onepagecrm_create_contact_note · Destructive: onepagecrm_get_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
